questions.q: The Union Public Service Commission submits its annual report to:
questions.solution:
Under Article 323, the Union Public Service Commission presents its annual report on the work it does to the President, who places it before Parliament.

**Answer: President**
questions.shortcut: Art. 323: UPSC report → President → laid before Parliament.

questions.q: A bill passed by both houses becomes law after:
questions.solution:
Under Article 111, a bill passed by both Houses of Parliament becomes law only after receiving the President's assent; no court or ministry approval is involved.

**Answer: President's assent**

questions.q: During which festival is the Bihu dance primarily performed?
questions.solution:
The Bihu dance is the folk dance of Assam, performed chiefly during the Rongali (Bohag) Bihu festival that marks the Assamese new year and the spring harvest.

**Answer: Bihu**

questions.q: Which place is the most famous center for Hola Mohalla celebrations?
questions.solution:
Hola Mohalla, the Sikh festival of martial displays and processions initiated by Guru Gobind Singh, is celebrated most famously at Anandpur Sahib in Punjab.

**Answer: Anandpur Sahib**
questions.shortcut: Hola Mohalla → Anandpur Sahib (held the day after Holi).

questions.q: The weight of an object on the moon is approximately what fraction of its weight on Earth?
questions.solution:
The moon's surface gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's, a direct consequence of its much smaller mass.

**Answer: 1/6**

questions.q: Who is the author of To Kill a Mockingbird?
questions.solution:
To Kill a Mockingbird (1960), Harper Lee's Pulitzer-winning novel on racial injustice in the American South, is her most famous work.

**Answer: Harper Lee**

questions.q: The Himalayas are divided into how many parallel ranges from north to south?
questions.solution:
From north to south the Himalayas consist of three parallel ranges — the Himadri (Greater Himalaya), Himachal (Lesser Himalaya) and Shiwalik (Outer Himalaya).

**Answer: Three**

questions.q: Which Indian program aims to reduce air pollution levels in 131 cities?
questions.solution:
The National Clean Air Programme (NCAP), launched in 2019, targets reduction of PM10/PM2.5 levels across 131 non-attainment and million-plus cities.

**Answer: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)**

questions.q: Which survey data is mainly used to calculate the Happiness Index?
questions.solution:
The World Happiness Report ranks countries mainly on responses to the Cantril life-ladder question carried in the Gallup World Poll.

**Answer: Gallup World Poll**
questions.shortcut: Happiness Index runs on Gallup World Poll data.

questions.q: Which layer of the Sun is visible during a total solar eclipse?
questions.solution:
During a total solar eclipse the Moon blocks the bright photosphere, letting the Sun's outermost atmosphere — the corona — show as a glowing halo around the dark disc.

**Answer: Corona**
questions.shortcut: Eclipse hides the photosphere; only the corona stays visible.

questions.q: Which country, other than Central Asian nations, directly benefits from Chabahar Port through India's aid delivery?
questions.solution:
India developed Chabahar Port in Iran mainly as a transit gateway to landlocked Afghanistan, which directly receives Indian aid shipments through it, in addition to benefiting Central Asian nations.

**Answer: Afghanistan**
questions.shortcut: Chabahar → sea route to Afghanistan, bypassing Pakistan.

questions.q: Which of the following correctly links a Five-Year Plan with the main challenge it faced?
options: First Plan - inflationary pressures from industrialization
Third Plan – food crisis and Indo-China war
Fourth Plan - heavy industrial investment shortages
Fifth Plan – underutilization of foreign exchange reserves
questions.solution:
The Third Plan (1961–66) was derailed by the food crisis and by the wars with China (1962) and Pakistan (1965); the other options misstate their plans' central challenges.

**Answer: Third Plan – food crisis and Indo-China war**
questions.shortcut: Third Plan = wars + food crisis; two plan failures in a row.

questions.q: Plastids are similar to which organelle in external structure?
questions.solution:
Plastids and mitochondria are both double-membraned organelles with their own DNA and ribosomes, so they resemble each other in external structure.

**Answer: Mitochondria**

questions.q: The Life Insurance Corporation of India was established in _____.
questions.solution:
The Life Insurance Corporation of India was set up on 1 September 1956 under the LIC Act, 1956, by merging 245 private insurance companies.

**Answer: 1956**

questions.q: Which soil is best suited for cotton cultivation?
questions.solution:
Black (regur) soil, formed from Deccan lava, retains moisture well and is rich in iron and magnesium — ideal for cotton, which is why it is nicknamed 'black cotton soil'.

**Answer: Black soil**

questions.q: What does the Urban Challenge Fund support?
options: ₹1 lakh crore for urban redevelopment, cities as growth hubs
questions.solution:
Announced in the Union Budget 2025–26, the ₹1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund supports urban redevelopment and helps cities position themselves as growth hubs.

**Answer: ₹1 lakh crore for urban redevelopment, cities as growth hubs**
questions.shortcut: Budget 2025–26: ₹1 lakh crore Urban Challenge Fund.

questions.q: The Mughal policy of Sulh-i-Kul emphasized:
questions.solution:
Sulh-i-kul ('peace with all'), the state policy associated with Akbar, emphasised religious tolerance and universal peace across all communities of the empire.

**Answer: Religious tolerance and universal peace**

questions.q: Which financial incentive is specifically extended to developers of Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in India to facilitate infrastructure creation?
questions.solution:
To help developers build infrastructure inside Special Economic Zones, the central government extends capital grants to them; the other listed incentives are either unit-focused or not the standard developer benefit.

**Answer: Capital grant from central government**
questions.shortcut: Developer-specific: central capital grant for infrastructure.

questions.q: The next census of India will be conducted by February 28 ______ .
questions.solution:
The government has notified that the next Census of India, with reference date 1 March 2027, will be completed by 28 February 2027 (snow-bound areas get an earlier reference date of 1 October 2026).

**Answer: 2027**

questions.q: Which Harappan site is located in Jammu and Kashmir?
questions.solution:
Manda, on the banks of the Chenab in the Jammu region, is the northernmost Harappan site, marking the civilisation's spread into Jammu and Kashmir. Kalibangan lies in Rajasthan, Banawali in Haryana and Lothal in Gujarat.

**Answer: Manda**
questions.shortcut: Manda = J&K; Kalibangan = Rajasthan; Lothal = Gujarat.
